description: Search the KEVWire corpus (CISA KEV, NVD high/critical CVEs, GitHub advisories, national CERTs, security reporting, editorial records) by words, technology, kind or exploitation. Use it to answer "is X affected" or "what is known about Y"; for a known ID use get_record, and for a plain "what is being exploited lately" list use list_recent_exploited. Default order is "urgent": the last 30 days first, then known exploitation, CVSS 9+, breaches. Results are paged (see hasMore and offset) and include source URLs to cite.

known_exploited_only.description: Only records in the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.

query.description: Words to match, e.g. "php rce", a CVE ID, a product, or an event name like "PHP2Shell".

technologies.description: Technology labels, e.g. ["Microsoft Windows", "PHP"]. Matches any.

name: search_vulnerabilities
title: Search vulnerabilities, breaches, and advisories
